youtube_description: In this August 2002 interview, Raja Petra Kamarudin tells of his arrest and detention without charge in April 2001 under the Malaysian Internal Security Act (ISA) - in September 2008 Raja Petra was arrested again, under the same ISA
youtube_title: Raja Petra Kamarudin- on his detention under Malaysia's ISA
